create_ELI5_dataset: create an ELI5 dataset instance for a given subreddit like eli5, asks, or askh
run_generate_k_shot_data: run generate_k_shot_data on an ELI5 dataset with k=32 examples and a random seed
load_eli5_hf_dataset: load the ELI5 dataset from Hugging Face using datasets.load_dataset
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a Hugging Face ELI5 dataset split to a list of input-output text tuples
get_train_test_lines: get shuffled train and test line pairs from an ELI5 dataset split
